name: game-kit
description: The first-person player and reusable HUD helpers for Volt 3D games: mouse look, walking, running, crouching, jumping, gravity, head bob, solid boxes, and a nine-slot hotbar with 1-9 selection. Written for import "game.volt" - World Studio adds that line for you. Configure HOTBAR_ITEMS and HOTBAR_COUNTS, call hotbarStep() each frame, and call hotbarDraw() after render3d.

snippets.label: Game kit (player, gravity, collision)
snippets.description: Normally used as import "game.volt". Includes player movement, collision and a reusable nine-slot hotbar (hotbarStep / hotbarDraw).
